text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: p99 latency spike (>6s) observed for /v1/generate in us-west2 since 02:12 UTC. Automated alerts: elevated streaming stalls and increased 5xx. Paging @alice (oncall) and @maria (sre).

alice (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Seeing alerts in Datadog, router tail latency up across multiple pods. Streaming sessions dropping at connector layer.

maria (sre): I'm tailing router logs now. There's a burst of misroutes where requests for shard keys are being concentrated. Seeing a lot of 502->200 patterns as retries land on a single node.

ben (runtime): Can you paste the shard heatmap? If one shard is hot we could be hitting a hot-partition + host-affinity combo.

maria (sre): heatmap snippet: 
```
heatmap: shard-42: 58% traffic (baseline 2-5%)
route_policy: route_weight_v3 active (deployed 01:50 UTC)
```

alice (oncall): That looks bad. Starting live mitigation checklist: 1) pause rollout of route_weight_v3 2) shift fractional traffic off shard-42 to fallback pool 3) spin up additional fallback capacity. Running dry-run first: `rbctl traffic-shift --region usw2 --from shard-42 --to fallback --dry-run`

chris (infra): On infra side I'm seeing a few egress proxies in usw2 with OOM and CPU throttling; autoscaler lag noted on fallback pool. That will make fallback slow to absorb traffic.

alice (oncall): Executing pause: `routectl rollout pause --policy route_weight_v3 --region usw2` -> pause acknowledged. Now applying reweight: 
```
routectl set-weights --policy route_weight_v3 --region usw2 --weights uniform
```

incident-bot: Action logged: pause_rollout by alice at 02:19 UTC; reweight job started.

ben (runtime): After reweight, p95 dropped from ~1.8s -> ~0.7s, but p99 still ~4.2s and streaming stalls persist on long sessions (>8k tokens). I suspect KV cache cold-start on the overloaded hosts; the hot shard had KV entries evicted.

maria (sre): I can see KV cache miss spike correlated with the misroutes. If the policy left affinity pinned for some keys, we could be thrashing the cache on that host.

chris (infra): Spinning up extra KV-warm instances and bumping fallback pool size now. `autoscaler set --pool fallback --min 6 --max 24 --region usw2` in progress.

alice (oncall): Customer-impact check: CS says two enterprise tenants in usw2 reported reconnects and partial streams starting ~02:15 UTC. Marking these for priority outreach. @customer-success pls send initial templated note and collect request ids.

customer-success: Acknowledged. Sending template and collecting failing request ids. Will attach logs once available. :email:

ben (runtime): Found policy-service log error at 02:11 UTC: 
```
ERR policy/eval.go:142: nil pointer deref reading seedMap
stack: policy/eval.go:42 -> router/proxy.go:178
```

maria (sre): That matches—policy eval failing could leave routing table in a transient skew where seeds didn't fully propagate, causing a tiny subset of keys to remain pinned to shard-42. Combined with a hot key pattern, this would blow up tail latency.

alice (oncall): Handoff: I'm leaving for the next handover window. @maria will own ongoing live mitigation and triage, @ben will watch model-serving caches and replay failing IDs, @chris will monitor autoscaler and infra health. Escalate to oncall-leads if p99 exceeds 5s again.

maria (sre): On it. Triage/action list I'm tracking: - complete rollback of route_weight_v3 if reweight not stable - audit policy seedMap propagation + add guardrails - replay failing request ids through a non-usw2 region - customer notification + timeline draft

ben (runtime): Starting replay on a small subset of failing ids to validate outputs and catch regressions. Posting trace link: https://trace.redwood/trace/abc123 (sanitized)

chris (infra): Fallback pool scaled to 18 nodes, KV warmers up. CPU/mem pressure easing on previously OOMing proxies.

alice (oncall): Monitoring windows: p95 now ~0.6s, p99 ~1.2s, streaming stall rate down ~93% vs peak. I'll open a postmortem and assign owners for RCA.

incident-bot: Severity updated to sev2. Incident marked as mitigated at 03:05 UTC. Postmortem required; assign to triage queue. Reminder: include timeline, policy rollout diff, heatmap, and customer impact section.

maria (sre): Quick note for RCA: hypothesized root cause = policy rollout bug that left seedMap partial (nil entries) causing skewed routing; hot-key + affinity concentrated load on shard-42 -> KV eviction/thrashing -> streaming stalls & tail spikes.

ben (runtime): Will add runtime traces and KV cache metrics to the postmortem. Also proposal: add defensive check in policy agent to validate seedMap completeness before applying new weights.

customer-success: Sending customer updates now. Will keep CS-rep loop in the postmortem.

alice (oncall): Thanks team. I'll finalize the incident doc with metrics and reopen if regressions. :thumbsup:
